# The Trichotomy Theorem {#sec-theorem}

One theorem, stated once, across the tower of strata from @sec-model.
Two previously separate results — $\EON$ and $\EALM$ — fall out of it as
corollaries rather than standing as independent theorems with proofs of
their own.

Fix an entry alphabet $R$, a commitment $\Gamma$ whose components sit at
stratum $Q$, and a claim $\Claim$ over $R$. The statements below hold
above the verification floor (@sec-floor).

::: {.theorem}
**$\TTsnap(Q)$.** $\Claim$ admits a snapshot-sound scheme with a
$Q$-verifier **iff** $\Det(\Claim)$ holds and $\phihat$ is
$Q$-certifiable.

Carriers: `snapshot_characterization` at $\oracle$;
`trichotomy_snap_COMP_iff` at $\computable$.
:::

::: {.theorem}
**$\TTend(Q)$.** $\Claim$ admits an enduring-sound scheme with a
$Q$-verifier **iff** $\Det(\Claim)$ holds, $\phihat$ is
$Q$-certifiable, and $\Mono(\Claim)$ holds.

Carriers: `trichotomy_ALL_iff` at $\oracle$; `comp_COMP_iff` at
$\computable$.
:::

$\TTend$ is $\TTsnap$ plus monotonicity — the only new demand an
enduring guarantee places on a claim already checkable at a snapshot.
That increment is itself a biconditional: with determination and
certifiability granted, an enduring scheme exists exactly when the claim
is monotone (`endurance_iff_monotone`).

## The direction that does the work

Both directions of both biconditionals are proved, and the paper's
central claim rests on the less obvious one.

The $\Rightarrow$ legs are the impossibility half, and each is a
separate small theorem: a scheme's existence forces determination
(`snapshot_characterization_determined`), forces certifiability of the
projection (`snapshot_characterization_np`), and — for the enduring
flavor — forces monotonicity (`endurance_forces_monotone`). Read
contrapositively, these are the statements that turn a failed axis into
an impossibility rather than a difficulty.

The $\Leftarrow$ leg is a **construction**. Given the three conditions,
`enduringScheme` *builds* a scheme: its certificate is a record paired
with a certifiability witness and a verification certificate, and its
verifier is the checker conjoined with the commitment's own
verification. `enduringScheme_enduringSound` proves the result
enduring-sound, and `endurance_construction` packages the two. Nothing
in that argument searches a space of candidate schemes and reports
success; it exhibits the scheme and proves it works.

This is what licenses the word "exactly." A fourth necessary condition
would have to be one the construction silently relies on, and the
construction is short enough to confirm that it does not — its only
inputs are determination, a checker, and upward-closure.
@sec-factorization makes the resulting count legible; it does not
establish it.

## Per-stratum status

The tower is graded honestly. Every cell is proved at every stratum this
paper claims, except the polynomial stratum, which is conjectural
throughout.

| flavor $\times$ stratum | verifier condition | status |
|:----|:----|:----|
| snapshot $\times$ oracle | none | proved (`snapshot_characterization`) |
| enduring $\times$ oracle | none | proved (`trichotomy_ALL_iff`) |
| snapshot $\times$ computable | commitment components computable | proved (`trichotomy_snap_COMP_iff`) |
| enduring $\times$ computable | and the verification-certificate predicate computable | proved (`comp_COMP_iff`) |
| snapshot / enduring $\times$ polynomial | polynomial time and size | open (conjectured) |

: Per-stratum status of $\TTsnap$ and $\TTend$. {#tbl-strata}

The polynomial stratum differs in kind from the rest of the tower. Its
theorems are not weakly proved or proved under extra hypotheses; they
are not proved at all, and no predicate in the development even encodes
the complexity bounds they would need (@sec-model). The paper states
that rather than implying three proved strata where one is open.

## One axis is degenerate at the oracle stratum

Oracle certifiability restricts nothing: every record predicate
satisfies `NPMembership`, and the mechanization proves this rather than
leaving it folklore (`npMembership_trivial`). So at $\oracle$, $\TTsnap$
collapses to determination alone (`snapshot_iff_determined_ALL`), and
the oracle rows above carry less content than their computable
counterparts. Reporting "three axes" at a stratum where one is satisfied
by everything would overstate the result: the trichotomy's effective
content lives at the computable stratum, which is why
@sec-factorization's display is stated there.

## Corollaries

**The determination gate.** Contrapositive of $\TTsnap(Q)$'s first
conjunct: a claim that is not record-determined admits no scheme, at any
stratum, of any soundness flavor (`determination_gate`, from
`snapshot_characterization_determined`). This is the trichotomy's most
basic consequence, the reason two cells of @sec-cell-table are empty by
theorem rather than by omission, and the single fact the companion
theorem of @sec-instances shares with this one.

**$\EALM$.** $\TTend(\oracle)$ presented fibered — determination and
certifiability supplied as hypotheses rather than stated inside the
existential. No content beyond the theorem above; a different packaging,
oriented toward a reader who already holds a determined, certifiable
claim and wants to know exactly what monotonicity buys
(`endurance_iff_monotone`).

**$\EON$.** The contrapositive of $\TTend(Q)$'s forward direction at a
claim known to be non-monotone: no enduring scheme exists, at any
stratum (`eon_trilemma_impossibility`). Where $\EALM$ answers "what do I
need, additionally, for endurance," $\EON$ answers "what have I lost,
permanently, once endurance is known to fail."

A companion theorem — the **verification ceiling** — generalizes the
gate above from append-only records to any well-founded justification
structure. @sec-instances introduces it, instantiates it twice, and
states its relationship to the theorem above precisely: it shares the
gate, but its completeness and minimality content is its own machinery
over a disjoint vocabulary, and is not a corollary of
$\TTsnap$/$\TTend$ in the sense the paragraphs above are.
